column1: 3.2 Resource Costs of Transacting A direct approach to modeling the role of money in facilitating transactions is to assume that the purchase of goods requires the input of transaction services. First a model is considered in which theses services are produced using inputs of money and time. Then an alternative approach is studied in which there are real resource costs in terms of goods that are incurred in purchasing consumption goods. Larger holdings of money allow the household to reduce the resource costs of producing transaction services.
